answers.answer: Two ways across: a tunnel by the station building (stairs, some with ramps, to all three platforms) and a footbridge north-west of it with lifts to platform 1 and perron 2 (OSM). DSB confirms stairs and elevator but not positions.

open: Lift to perron 3 (tracks 4/5): OSM maps none; DSB gives no detail.
Bus terminal: not described by DSB; not checked with Movia.
Signposted names of tunnel/footbridge: none found. No owner plan found.
OSM footbridge w1498175892 (layer 1) at the south-east end: purpose not settled (possibly a road/path bridge).
